title: galium halleri
intro: Galium halleri, commonly known as Alpenrose or Haller's bedstraw, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Galium halleri include its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as iridoid glycosides and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Galium halleri contribute to its potential therapeutic uses, including wound healing, fever reduction, and the alleviation of gastrointestinal issues.
